page.layout: Two printed columns on one page, a Hebrew-Latin dictionary. Left column: entries from רב to רוח. Right column: entries from רוח to רפסה. Running heads at the top of each column. Page number at top right. Signature at the foot left, catchword at the foot right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: רַב magnus, princeps, magister, רַבָּא magnus, רַבָּתָא magna, No. s. m. & f. emph. רַבִּין magni, רַבְּרָבָן, רַבְּרָבְתָּא magnae, רַבְּרְבָנִי magnates mei, רַבְּרְבָנָךְ tui, רַבְּרְבָנוֹהִי ejus, No. pl. m. f. emph. & aff. רְבוֹ myrias, רִבְבָן myriades, No. f. & pl. R. רבב.
רָבָה crevit, רַבִּית crevisti, praet. 3. peh. m. f. & 2. רַבֵּי magnificavit, praet. pah. רְבוּתָא amplitudo, רְבוּתָךְ tua, No. f. pro emph. & aff. R. רבה.
רְבִיעָאָה רְבִיעָאָה רְבִיעָתָא quarta, No. f. f. emph. R. רבע.
רְגַז ira, No. f. R. רגז.
רַגְלַיָּא pedes, רַגְלֵי ejus, רַגְלֵיהּ ejus, No. du. emph. aff. R. רגל.
רְוָה forma ejus, No. m. aff. R. רנא.
רוּחַ ventus, spiritus, רוּחִי meus, רוּחָה ejus, רוּחִי venti, No. f. abs. emp. aff. pl. constr. R. רוח.
רוּמָה altitudo ejus, No. f. aff. R. רום.
רָזָא arcanum, רָזִין arcana; No: f. & pl. abs. & emph. R. רז.
רַחִיקִין remoti, No. pl. m. R. רחק.
רַחֲמִין misericordiae, No. pl. abs. R. רחם.
רֵיחַ odor, No. f. R. ריח.
רָם elatus est, praet. peh. cum chirek. R. רום.
רָמוּ projecerunt, praet. pl. peh. רְמִינָא projecimus, praet. 3. & 1. plur. peh. R. רמה.
רְעוּת voluntas, No. f. רְעוּנֵי cogitationes, רְעוּנָךְ tuae, רְעוּנֵהִי ejus, No. pl. constr. & aff. R. רעה.
רַעֲנַן virens, No. f. R. רען.

page.notes: Hebrew words are copied from a small printed type and several vowel points are uncertain; the Hebrew forms in the entries, especially the vowel marks on רְוָה, רַגְלַיָּא and the plural forms in the right column, may contain errors. No [?] markers were placed inside the Hebrew because the uncertainty is general. The left column's last line "רוּחַ ventus" continues into the right column's first line "tus". Line-initial Hebrew lemmas are kept as separate paragraphs, one per entry.
